title: Akiyama Mizuki — Designing My Own Tomorrow〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhumm♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hair, check! Makeup, check! Outfit, check...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Sis! Are you ready to head out?
I'm set to go whenever!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh. It's the weekend, but it's still nice and empty this early in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah, we shouldn't have to wait to use any of the fitting rooms.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It is common for big lines to form at the really popular shops.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena and I usually have to spend a bunch of time waiting whenever we go shopping, since we tend to go in the afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then, why don't you two try to wake up early like we did today and come in the morning?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way. I mean, Ena just isn't a morning person.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She will wake up early to buy something she really wants or go somewhere she's set on visiting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But even for those times, she usually has Li'l Bro wake her up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. The Shinonome siblings seem really close, just like us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, yeah... I guess?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's more that Ena won't wake up even with her super-loud alarm clock, so Li'l Bro has to go in and yell at her, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki, was the shop you wanted to visit this way?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! Just keep going straight!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I made a whole list of all the shops I wanna visit with you, Sis, so you better be prepared!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Alright, challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on my hair and outfit, I'll probably wanna find hair accessories that are white-ish, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Probably. But something covered in decorative gemstones could also work. Like this one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you're right. It's pretty flashy, but it fits in surprisingly well when you put it on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Does it fit, Sis? Do you need more time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: A little bit more.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Hmm... This jacket also seems good, but I could go for more of a relaxed look with this cardigan...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Sis, wait!
Don't decide all by yourself! Let me help!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This accessory shop even sells DIY kits and stuff, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I've been coming here a lot lately!
And they have even more stuff in the back, so let's go in♪
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew. All this walking has really made me hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Me too. Hmm... What should I order...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki, that reminds me.
You and your group come here often, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we usually throw our after-parties here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then, I might just base my order on what Ena and the others usually get.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What Ena and the others usually get...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
Aren't you gonna ask what I usually get?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
You're just gonna order the curry, right?
And a mountain of French fries.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's right...
But that's not all, you know? I'll order their Salisbury steak and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Sorry, sorry.
Then, can you tell me what you like to get too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First, I'll order their piping-hot Salisbury steak set! It's pretty hard to eat because it is seriously hot, but it's also really good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade usually gets something from the noodles section. I think she gets their wonton noodles the most!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thing is, until not too long ago, Kanade was practically living off of instant noodles each day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she's been eating much more properly lately. She even said that she looks forward to having the noodles here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Next, we have Mafuyu.
She usually gets a plate of pasta.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she doesn't really order based on what she wants to eat. She doesn't want to read through the menu, so she just always picks the first thing that's listed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then there's Ena, who usually orders some sort of dessert. But she'll share some of her parfaits and cakes with us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! Whenever Ena's watching her calorie intake or trying to be healthy, she'll just order salad...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she never feels full, and usually ends up ordering from the dessert menu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, that's just about everything we usually order♪ Did it help?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes, a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But we do have a bit of a problem.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A problem?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I was so focused on how much fun you were having talking about your friends that I missed about half of what you said.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
I told you all that to try to help you, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Sorry, sorry! But you had such a big smile on your face, and it's really clear how much you love them all, so I just couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Can we call it even if I pay today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, fine...
I'll tell you everything again, so listen closely.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Honestly...
